title: The Gene Expression Patterns in the Peripheral White Blood Cells of Type 2 Diabetic Patients
brief_summary: The investigators hypothesize that macrophages play a crucial role in the pathogenesis of atherosclerosis in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Normal control: fasting plasma glucose (FPG) less than 126 mg/dl.
* T2DM: FPG \>＝126 mg/dl.

  * Group 1 (good glycemic control): HbA1c\<＝7% in the past 6 months
  * Group 2 (poor glycemic control): HbA1c\>＝8% in the past 6 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Acute systemic diseases
